scope: Current cache and directional prefetch regression validation

coverage: Independent RAM/disk byte, count, TTL and queue limits
Atomic combined limits with visible pins and leases
Pressure restore refusal retaining swap for retry
Cancellation releasing partial buffers and pending queue owners
Idle and continuously active TTL worker cleanup
Replacement races and concurrent restore budget accounting
Deterministic weighted LRU model with 50000 operations
Forward/backward bounded windows and gallery edges
Byte and count priority under missing files

limitations: Filtered and ignored tests are not counted as passing.
These tests do not establish full large-collection, slow-disk, sustained-pressure or physical HDR/NVIDIA qualification.

real_source_followup.remaining_unrun: SRF and authored EIP prefetch tests were excluded from these runs.

verified: Missing SRF neighbour does not consume retained-entry count
EIP forward/backward prefetch preserves every sensor sample and metadata
Equal-sized equal-mtime EIP packages have separate complete-package fingerprint keys
EIP one-entry disk limit and shared memory return-to-zero
